generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Rates shall be quoted in tender in bill of quantities in the website itself.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work at his own cost.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the Joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy 26 PPT 2022 dtd.26.04.2022
Bidders shall undertake to comply with the entire requirement under EPF and MP Act 1952 and cover all the workmen to be engaged for the work entrusted by the corporation under the PF Act.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, labor welfare cess etc., and other statutory taxes, duties, levies, cess as applicable at the prevailing rates under GoK/GoI Acts and relevant notifications

In case of the death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
Defect liability/Maintenance period for the work is 12 (Twelve) months from the date of completion of the work.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
In the item description in Schedule-B, the material to be used for the work should confirm with relevant IS standards. The material can be procured/used only after approval from Engineer in charge

The location where the work is to be carried out is to be completely studied. Any electrical cables, power cables, transformers, OFC, etc., laid need to be understood. The safety of men, material and instruments is to be strictly taken care. Any lapse/ incidents/ accidents/loss is the total responsibility of bidder.
The contract may be foreclosed/extended beyond the original contract period as per the decision of KPCL

Electric Power/Water required for carrying out the work will be made available free of cost to the extent possible and bidder shall exercise utmost care for judicious use of the same. Any extension could be made by the contractor at his/her own cost.
The corporation is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-proc portal.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the e-proc portal only

GST: (a) In KPPP Portal it is mentioned as Inclusive of all taxes whereas rates uploaded are exclusive of GST. Agency has to quote the rates exclusive of GST. GST will be added at prevailing rates at the time of Agreement. (b) As per Govt. order FD:447: Exependiture:12/2022 Bangalore dt. 30-7-2022 G.S.T will be paid at 18% or applicable rates at the time of payment of RA Bills, subject to verification.

In KPPP Portal it is mentioned as Inclusive of all taxes whereas rates uploaded/amount put to tender is exclusive of GST. Agency has to quote the rates exclusive of GST. GST will be added at prevailing rates at the time of Agreement.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Superintending Engineer RO (Civil), KPCL, Bengaluru-560001 during office hours (9.30 am to 5.00pm)

Polishing in high gloss/matt finish melamine clear polish on wood work in required color/wooden shade texture with following process in the sequence as detailed below:
1. The surface to be polished is rubbed with sand paper 80/120 no. and then with sand paper of 160/180 no.
2. Applying two coats of sealer with spray gun and allowing sufficient drying time for 1st coat and 2nd coat is allowed to dry for 8 to 12 hrs.
3. On drying of sealer coat, wet rubbing with emery cloth of finer grading with ample water to remove excess sealer layer and make the surface further smooth after this wet rubbing, then surface is applied with special grade melamine fillers to fill all the small and big holes/grooves etc. Filler coat to be allowed to dry for 4 to 6 hrs on which again a light wet rubbing is done this surface is further allowed to dry for 12 hrs. 4. On this, 1st coat of melamine polish is applied with spray gun using melamine clear polish and melamine thinner in required proportion. This 1st coat is allowed to dry for 24 hrs then this dry surface is again fine wet rubbed smooth, which is further allowed to dry for 12 hrs. The final melamine polish is applied with compressor pressure spray gun using melamine clear polish and melamine thinner mixed in required proportion complete as per direction of Engineer-in-Charge. (Final coat to be done in 1 or 2 layers without gap of time.)
